objective: Exercise three fresh single-proposition Contract-A-valid cases end-to-end through the frozen CAL Pipeline, retain one declared/all_of case as a decomposition-boundary probe, and test provenance instrumentation as a non-interfering sidecar by paired control/instrumented execution.

gate_v1.note: Frozen downstream compatibility tree. Use only prepared Contract-A-valid source representations in this series.

evidence_bundler.admission: none; omit --admission so retained candidates remain needs-review

paired_execution.control: Run exact pipeline without generating provenance attestations or RunManifest sidecars.
paired_execution.instrumented: Repeat from the exact same frozen input packet and component/config identities, adding only already-qualified provenance sidecars/retention.
paired_execution.comparison_rule: Require byte identity where the frozen apparatus is deterministic. If a non-semantic wrapper receipt differs only by output path/run-local metadata, preserve and classify that difference rather than weakening semantic equality.

cases.note: Gate/A/EB front half is expected to run. Current canonical CAL run-bundle consumes one typed Contract B claim at a time; do not synthesize an unqualified root all_of aggregator. Preserve the child-claim boundary and report the exact stopping point.
Successor representation case. The prior text/html failure remains frozen separately and is not reinterpreted.

pass_conditions: The three cases marked fresh_single_proposition_full_chain have exact frozen CAL typed-target files bound to their root Contract B claim text; their semantic family is explicitly unsupported so CAL may legitimately return UNSUPPORTED_SEMANTIC_FAMILY while still exercising the canonical B intake.
All four Gate outputs match the preregistered authoring state and emit Contract A.
All four emitted Contract A objects validate under exact released Contract A 2.0.0 authority.
All four exact Contract A objects are accepted by frozen EB V1 and produce native package + Contract B 1.2.
Control and instrumented runs use identical causal inputs, compatibility carrier, component identities, and policies.

For every stage that executes in both modes, authoritative/native outputs are byte-identical across control and instrumented runs unless a documented run-local non-semantic field is the sole difference.
Instrumented runs preserve every required artifact and produce candidate manifest roots without self-authorizing them.
Failures, abstentions, not_checkable, HOLD, and downstream non-execution remain exact if observed.
nonclaims: No Gate V1.0.0 publication permission; PR #50 separately falsifies general released Contract A producer conformance for unsupported media representations.
